pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the ADR0127 continuation by adding the first-party Native 2D proving-project option to the standard Launcher flow. The template is authored through a sibling staging project and publishes only after its Camera2D, Sprite Atlas/Animation, sparse TileMap, CharacterController2D, Collider2D and one-way-platform content has been written successfully.

Existing Empty project creation remains the default.
